projects.aside: Personal projects, live online. Each one started from a concrete need.

title: Mi profe
de inglés.
miProfe.description: I'm learning English, and even though I take classes, I needed a way to practice outside of them. That's how Mi profe was born: an app that uses an AI agent to generate English sentences, assess my listening comprehension and identify patterns in my mistakes. Instead of just correcting me, the system detects which areas I need to reinforce so it can guide my practice. The project also includes automated tests, Docker and a CI/CD pipeline that automates integration and deployment.
miProfe.caption: PROJECT 001 — AI AGENT

title: LicitaSimple.
licitaSimple.description: Small businesses can't read hundreds of tender documents on Chile's public procurement platform. LicitaSimple shows them which tenders they can bid on based on what they do and explains it in plain language, powered by an agent with a tool-use loop.
licitaSimple.caption: PROJECT 002 — AI AGENT

title: This
portfolio.
portfolio.description: This very site, built with Claude, Anthropic's AI. I gave it the instructions and a design skill, defined the stack and architecture, reviewed every change, and handled the deployment and domain.
portfolio.caption: PROJECT 003 — WITH AI

title: I learn
by building.
about.p1: I'm from Esquel, a small town at the foot of the Andes in Argentina's Patagonia, and now live in Viña del Mar, Chile. I have three years of experience as a full stack developer and currently work on a team that builds and maintains a platform built on microservices.
about.p2: Much of what I know I taught myself: when I don't understand something, I build a project to learn it. That's how Mi profe and LicitaSimple started. Both run on my own Oracle Cloud server, at a monthly cost close to zero.
about.p3: At work I care about the how as much as the what: I like to understand the underlying problem before writing a single line of code. I value constant feedback, since it's what helps me improve the most, and I enjoy working as part of a team.
